# Prodigy Education

> Prodigy Education is a game-based learning platform that makes math and English fun, curriculum-aligned, and adaptive for students in grades 1–8. Used by nearly 800,000 teachers across 70,000+ schools and trusted by millions of families worldwide.

Prodigy offers two core products — Prodigy Math and Prodigy English — both free for students, teachers, and schools. The platform pairs engaging role-playing game mechanics with standards-aligned skill practice to drive measurable academic outcomes. Teachers, parents, administrators, and homeschooling families each have dedicated pages, dashboards, tools, and reports.

## Site Metadata

- Canonical domain: https://www.prodigygame.com
- URL pattern for locale: `/main-en/[slug]` (English default) · `/es/[slug]` (Spanish) · `/pt/[slug]` (Portuguese)
- URL pattern for blog posts: `/main-en/blog/[post-slug]`
- URL pattern for homeschool sub-pages: `/main-en/homeschoolers/[slug]`
- URL pattern for teacher tool sub-pages: `/main-en/teachers/[slug]`
- Last published: 2026-05-22
- Primary language: `en`
- Alternate languages: `es`, `pt`

## Core Products

- [Prodigy Math](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/prodigy-math): Adaptive math practice set in a fantasy RPG world. Students answer curriculum-aligned questions to battle enemies, complete quests, and earn rewards. Covers hundreds of skills across grades 1–8. Teachers can assign content, run assessments, and track progress.
- [Prodigy English](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/prodigy-english): A world-building English game that develops reading and language skills. Students learn, gather resources, and construct their own world through structured literacy practice.
- [Math Facts Practice](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/math-facts-practice): Focused fluency practice for foundational math facts, integrated into the Prodigy experience.

## Audiences

- [For Teachers](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/teachers): Free, standards-aligned math and English games for grades 1–8. Teachers get one-click login, class rostering, assignments, reports, and motivational tools. Trusted by nearly 800,000 educators in 70,000+ schools. No cost to teachers or schools.
- [For Parents](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/parents): Tools to support children's math and English learning at home. The parent dashboard provides progress tracking, goal-setting, and insight into what skills kids are practising. Free to use; premium membership available.
- [For Administrators](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/administrators): District-wide adoption at no cost, including teacher professional development. Privacy-first and independently evaluated as one of the best platforms for student data safety and security.
- [For Homeschoolers](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/homeschoolers): Adaptive, standards-aligned math program designed for home learning. Offers flexibility of self-paced learning with real-time progress reports so parents don't need to be math experts. Prodigy is an approved vendor with ESA, Scholarship, and Grant programs — homeschooling families can use state funds to fully fund a Prodigy Ultra membership.

## Why Prodigy

- Game-based learning that students genuinely want to play, reducing resistance to practice
- Adaptive algorithm personalizes question difficulty and content to each student's level
- Curriculum-aligned to state and national standards across all 50 US states, Canada, and Australia
- Free core experience for all teachers, students, and schools — no budget required
- Proven results: students with heavy Prodigy use significantly outperformed peers in California end-of-year assessments

## Research & Credibility

- [Research](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/research): Independent studies and Prodigy's own efficacy research. A California study found students with heavy Prodigy use vastly outperformed non-users. Platform content is research-based and standards-aligned.
- [Math Curriculum Standards](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/math-curriculum-standards): Full breakdown of how Prodigy Math maps to state and national math curriculum standards.
- [English Language Curriculum Standards](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/english-language-curriculum-standards): Coverage map for Prodigy English against language arts standards.

## Homeschool Tools & Funding

- [Homeschoolers Overview](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/homeschoolers): Full hub for homeschooling families — adaptive math program, self-paced learning, curriculum progress reports, and parent dashboards included with Prodigy Ultra.
- [ESA, Scholarships & Grants](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/homeschoolers/grant-funds): Prodigy is an approved ESA vendor. Step-by-step state-by-state instructions for redeeming education savings accounts and scholarship funds via ClassWallet, Odyssey, and Theodore. Covers how to use state ESA and scholarship programs to fund Prodigy memberships at no out-of-pocket cost.

## Teacher Tools

- [Assessments](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/teachers/assessments): Assign and review diagnostic and formative assessments within the game.
- [Reports](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/teachers/reports): Class and individual student performance reports to identify gaps and growth.
- [Rewards](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/teachers/rewards): In-game motivational tools teachers can use to incentivise student participation and effort.

## Company

- [About Prodigy Education](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/about-prodigy): Founded in 2011 as an undergraduate project. Mission: help every student in the world love learning. Headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
- [Blog](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/blog): Teaching tips, research summaries, classroom strategies, and product updates for educators and parents. CMS-driven; new posts published regularly.
- [Newsroom](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/prodigy-newsroom): Press releases, media coverage, and company announcements.
- [Careers](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/jobs): Open roles at Prodigy Education.
- [Resources](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/resources): Free classroom resources, guides, and printables for educators.

## Special Programs

- [State Challenge / National Cup](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/state-challenge/national-cup): Competitive in-game events that motivate students across schools and states to practise math.
- [State Challenge](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/state-challenge): Regional math challenges with leaderboards for classrooms and schools.

## Legal & Safety

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/privacy-policy): How Prodigy collects, uses, and protects user data.
- [Privacy Policy for Students](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/privacy-policy-for-students): Student-specific privacy practices and COPPA/FERPA compliance.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/terms-and-conditions): Platform terms of use.

## Localization

Prodigy is available in English, Spanish (`/es`), and Portuguese (`/pt`), with content aligned to curriculum standards across North America, the UK, and Australia. Hreflang signals are implemented in page `<head>` on each Webflow page.

## CMS Notes

Dynamic content (blog posts, resource pages, ESA state guides) is served from CMS collections. Static audience and product pages are published as individual pages under the `/main-en/` path prefix. LLM crawlers should treat `/main-en/blog/` URLs as CMS collection items and expect new slugs to be added without notice as the editorial team publishes new content.

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeProdigyHeader)

function initializeProdigyHeader() {
  if (window.__PRODIGY_HEADER_INITIALIZED__) return
  window.__PRODIGY_HEADER_INITIALIZED__ = true

  const CONSTANTS = {
    LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY: "prodigyLanguage",
    LANGS: {
      EN: "EN",
      ES: "ES",
      PT: "PT"
    },
    PATH_PREFIXES: {
      ES: "/es",
      PT: "/pt",
      EN: "/main-en"
    }
  }

  function safelyGetNavigatorLanguage() {
    try {
      return navigator.language || navigator.userLanguage || ""
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return ""
    }
  }

  function safelyGetLocalStorageItem(key) {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(key)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return null
    }
  }

  function safelySetLocalStorageItem(key, value) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, value)
      return true
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return false
    }
  }

  function normalizeLang(value) {
    if (!value) return null
    const v = String(value).trim().toLowerCase()
    if (v.startsWith("en")) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.EN
    if (v.startsWith("es")) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES
    if (v.startsWith("pt")) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT
    return null
  }

  function safelyParseUrl(url) {
    try {
      return new URL(url, window.location.href)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return null
    }
  }

  function redirectTo(url) {
    try {
      window.location.replace(url)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      window.location.href = url
    }
  }

  function getSavedLang() {
    return normalizeLang(safelyGetLocalStorageItem(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY))
  }

  function setSavedLang(lang) {
    safelySetLocalStorageItem(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY, lang)
  }

  function getCurrentPathType(pathname) {
    const p = pathname || window.location.pathname || "/"
    if (p.startsWith(CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.ES)) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES
    if (p.startsWith(CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.PT)) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT
    return CONSTANTS.LANGS.EN
  }

  function stripKnownLanguagePrefixes(pathname) {
    const p = pathname || "/"
    const noEsPt = p.replace(/^\/(es|pt)(?=\/|$)/, "")
    const noMainEn = noEsPt.replace(/^\/main-en(?=\/|$)/, "")
    return noMainEn || "/"
  }

  function buildPathForLang(lang, pathname) {
    const stripped = stripKnownLanguagePrefixes(pathname)
    if (lang === CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES) return `${CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.ES}${stripped}`
    if (lang === CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT) return `${CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.PT}${stripped}`
    return `${CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.EN}${stripped}`
  }

  function getPreferredLang() {
    const saved = getSavedLang()
    if (saved) return saved

    const browser = normalizeLang(safelyGetNavigatorLanguage())
    if (browser === CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES
    if (browser === CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT

    return CONSTANTS.LANGS.EN
  }

  function autoRedirectIfNeeded() {
    const pathname = window.location.pathname || "/"

    const isExplicitEs = pathname.startsWith(CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.ES)
    const isExplicitPt = pathname.startsWith(CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.PT)

    if (isExplicitEs || isExplicitPt) return

    const preferred = getPreferredLang()
    const currentType = getCurrentPathType(pathname)

    if (preferred === currentType) return

    const nextPath = buildPathForLang(preferred, pathname)
    const nextUrl = `${nextPath}${window.location.search}${window.location.hash}`
    redirectTo(nextUrl)
  }

  function handleLanguageLinkClick(event) {
    const anchor = event.target && event.target.closest ? event.target.closest("a[hreflang]") : null
    if (!anchor) return

    const lang = normalizeLang(anchor.getAttribute("hreflang"))
    if (!lang) return

    event.preventDefault()
    setSavedLang(lang)

    const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || ""
    const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref)
    if (!parsed) return

    redirectTo(parsed.toString())
  }
}
</script>

    beforeSend(event) {

      const frames = event.exception && event.exception.values

        : []

      if (frames.some(f => f && f.filename && __prodigyIsBlockedDomain__(f.filename))) return null

      const crumbs = event.breadcrumbs || []

        const url = c && c.data && c.data.url ? c.data.url : c && c.message ? c.message : ""
        const category = c && c.category ? c.category : ""
        return category.match(/xhr|fetch|http/i) && __prodigyIsBlockedDomain__(url)
      })) return null

      const msg = String(event.message || "").toLowerCase()
      if ((msg.includes("load failed") || msg.includes("failed to fetch")) && event.request && event.request.url && __prodigyIsBlockedDomain__(event.request.url)) {
        return null
      }

      return event
    }
  })

<script>
  document.querySelectorAll('.testimonial-player').forEach((player) => {
    const video = player.querySelector('.testimonial-video');
    const playButton = player.querySelector('.play-button-testimonial');
    const playPauseBtn = player.querySelector('.playPauseBtn');
    const progressBar = player.querySelector('.testimonial-progress-bar');
    const progressFilled = player.querySelector('.progress-filled-testimonial');
    const controls = player.querySelector('.controls-testimonial');

    let previewMode = true; // loop 3s before play, muted until user presses play

    // Preview looping
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
      if (previewMode && video.currentTime >= 3) {
        video.pause();
        video.currentTime = 0;
        video.play();
      }
    });

    function startRealPlayback() {
      if (!previewMode) return;

      previewMode = false; // disables preview loop
      video.muted = false;
      video.currentTime = 0;
      video.play(); // starts real playback

      playButton.style.display = 'none';
      controls.style.opacity = 1;
      controls.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
    }

    function togglePlay() {
      if (previewMode) {
        startRealPlayback();
        return;
      }

      if (video.paused || video.ended) {
        video.play();
      } else {
        video.pause();
      }
    }

    function updateButton() {
      playPauseBtn.textContent = video.paused ? '▶' : '⏸';

      if (!previewMode) {
        playButton.style.display = video.paused ? 'flex' : 'none';
      }
    }

    function handleProgress() {
      if (!previewMode) {
        const percent = (video.currentTime / video.duration) * 100;
        progressFilled.style.width = percent + '%';
      }
    }

    function scrub(e) {
      if (previewMode) return;

      const scrubTime = (e.offsetX / progressBar.offsetWidth) * video.duration;
      video.currentTime = scrubTime;
    }

    playButton.addEventListener('click', togglePlay);
    playPauseBtn.addEventListener('click', togglePlay);

    video.addEventListener('play', updateButton);
    video.addEventListener('pause', updateButton);
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', handleProgress);

    progressBar.addEventListener('click', scrub);
  });
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeProdigySite);

  function initializeProdigySite() {
    if (window.__PRODIGY_SITE_INITIALIZED__) return;
    window.__PRODIGY_SITE_INITIALIZED__ = true;

    const CONSTANTS = {
      HOMEPAGES: [
        "/main-en",
        "/es",
        "/pt",
        "/main-en/home-a",
        "/main-en/home-b",
        "/main-en/home-2",
      ],
      TEACHER_EXCEPTIONS: [
        "/main-en/top-teachers",
        "/main-en/teachers-lp-m",
        "/main-en/teachers-lp",
        "/main-en/teacher-platform",
        "/main-en/web/teachers-m-bts",
        "/main-en/web/teachers-b-bts",
      ],
      CONTENT_PREFIXES: ["/blog", "/players", "/prodigy-newsroom"],
      AGE_GATE_COOKIES: {
        teacher: "teacherSelectedV2",
        parent: "parentSelectedV2",
        play: "playProdigyV2",
      },
      SKIP_AGE_GATE_SESSION_KEY: "skipAgeGate",
      SSO_PRESERVE_TEACHER_PARENT_ROUTES: false,
      SSO_REWRITE_DATASET_KEY: "prodigySsoRewritten",
      SSO_PRESERVE_PATHS_REGEX: /^\/(?:signup\/)?(teachers|parents)\/signup$/i,
      BUTTON_TRACKING: {
        EVENT_NAME: "Button Clicked",
        SELECTOR: "a.btn, a.w-button, a[data-wf--button--variant]",
        TIMEOUT_MS: 500,
      },
      LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN: {
        DESKTOP: ".dropdown-language-wrapper",
        MOBILE: ".dropdown-language-wrapper2",
        HIDDEN_CLASS: "hidden",
        VISIBLE_TLD: ".org",
      },
      SUGGESTED_LANG_PARAM: "suggested_lang",
      MEMBERSHIP_PATH_REGEX: /\/membership(\/math)?\/?$/i,
      HASH_SCROLL_EXTRA_OFFSET: 16,
    };

    const SELECTORS = {
      primaryNavbar: ".navbar--primary",
      navbarWrapper: ".navbar--wrapper",
      logo: ".navbar__logo",
      ageGateSection: ".section-age-gate",
      btnPlay: "#btn-play-prodigy",
      btnEducators: "#btn-prodigy-for-educators",
      btnParents: "#btn-prodigy-for-parents",
      accordionHeaders: ".accordion__header.w-dropdown-toggle",
    };

    const HOMEPAGE_SET = new Set(
      CONSTANTS.HOMEPAGES.map((p) => p.replace(/\/$/, "")),
    );
    const TEACHER_EXCEPTION_SET = new Set(
      CONSTANTS.TEACHER_EXCEPTIONS.map((p) => p.replace(/\/$/, "")),
    );

    function getElement(selector, scope = document) {
      return scope.querySelector(selector);
    }

    function getElements(selector, scope = document) {
      return Array.from(scope.querySelectorAll(selector));
    }

    function addEvent(element, eventName, handler) {
      if (element) element.addEventListener(eventName, handler);
    }

    function safelyParseUrl(url) {
      try {
        return new URL(url, window.location.href);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        return null;
      }
    }

    function setCookie(name, value, days) {
      try {
        const date = new Date();
        date.setTime(date.getTime() + days * 86400000);

        const base = `${encodeURIComponent(name)}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; expires=${date.toUTCString()}; path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
        const secure = window.location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";

        document.cookie = `${base}${secure}`;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }
    }

    function getCookie(name) {
      const encodedName = `${encodeURIComponent(name)}=`;
      const cookies = document.cookie.split(";");
      for (const c of cookies) {
        const cookie = c.trim();
        if (cookie.startsWith(encodedName)) {
          const rawValue = cookie.substring(encodedName.length);
          try {
            return decodeURIComponent(rawValue);
          } catch (error) {
            console.error(error);
            return rawValue;
          }
        }
      }
      return null;
    }

    const pathname = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "") || "/";
    const hostname = window.location.hostname;
    const domainMatch = hostname.match(/prodigygame\.(com|net|org)$/);
    const domainTld = domainMatch ? domainMatch[1] : null;
    const domain = domainTld ? `prodigygame.${domainTld}` : null;
    const ssoBase = domain ? `https://sso.${domain}` : null;
    const mainEnBase = domain ? `https://www.${domain}/main-en` : null;
    const ssoHostname = ssoBase
      ? (safelyParseUrl(ssoBase)?.hostname ?? null)
      : null;
    const primaryNavbar = getElement(SELECTORS.primaryNavbar);
    const navbarWrapper = getElement(SELECTORS.navbarWrapper);

    function getLocale() {
      if (pathname.startsWith("/es")) return "es";
      if (pathname.startsWith("/pt")) return "pt";
      return null;
    }

    function isMembershipPath(path) {
      return CONSTANTS.MEMBERSHIP_PATH_REGEX.test(path || "");
    }

    function appendLocaleParameter(url) {
      const locale = getLocale();
      if (!locale) return url;

      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(url);
      if (!parsed) return url;

      const key = CONSTANTS.SUGGESTED_LANG_PARAM;
      const shouldForce = isMembershipPath(parsed.pathname);

      if (shouldForce) {
        parsed.searchParams.set(key, locale);
        return parsed.toString();
      }

      if (!parsed.searchParams.has(key)) {
        parsed.searchParams.set(key, locale);
      }

      return parsed.toString();
    }

    function isHomepagePath() {
      return HOMEPAGE_SET.has(pathname);
    }

    function shouldSkipAgeGateOnce() {
      const key = CONSTANTS.SKIP_AGE_GATE_SESSION_KEY;
      if (!sessionStorage.getItem(key)) return false;
      sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
      return true;
    }

    function normalizeProdigyHostname(host) {
      if (!domainTld) return host;
      const match = host.match(/^(.*\.)?prodigygame\.(com|org|net)$/i);
      if (!match) return host;
      const subdomain = match[1] || "";
      return `${subdomain}prodigygame.${domainTld}`;
    }

    function rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(url) {
      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(url);
      if (!parsed) return null;
      const nextHostname = normalizeProdigyHostname(parsed.hostname);
      if (nextHostname !== parsed.hostname) {
        parsed.hostname = nextHostname;
      }
      return parsed.toString();
    }

    function isHashOnlyHref(rawHref) {
      if (!rawHref) return false;
      const trimmed = rawHref.trim();
      return trimmed.startsWith("#") && trimmed.length > 1;
    }

    function buildCurrentPageHashUrl(rawHref) {
      if (!isHashOnlyHref(rawHref)) return null;
      return `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${rawHref.trim()}`;
    }

    function areSameNormalizedHostnames(left, right) {
      return normalizeProdigyHostname(left) === normalizeProdigyHostname(right);
    }

    function isSamePageHashLink(rawHref) {
      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
      if (!parsed || !parsed.hash) return false;

      const current = safelyParseUrl(window.location.href);
      if (!current) return false;

      return (
        areSameNormalizedHostnames(parsed.hostname, current.hostname) &&
        parsed.pathname === current.pathname &&
        parsed.search === current.search
      );
    }

    function isInPageHashLink(rawHref) {
      return isHashOnlyHref(rawHref) || isSamePageHashLink(rawHref);
    }

    function getHashTarget(hash) {
      if (!hash) return null;

      const rawId = hash.replace(/^#/, "");
      if (!rawId) return null;

      let decodedId = rawId;
      try {
        decodedId = decodeURIComponent(rawId);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }

      const byId = document.getElementById(decodedId);
      if (byId) return byId;

      try {
        const escaped =
          window.CSS && typeof window.CSS.escape === "function"
            ? window.CSS.escape(decodedId)
            : decodedId.replace(/["\\]/g, "\\$&");
        const named = document.querySelector(`[name="${escaped}"]`);
        if (named) return named;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }

      return null;
    }

    function getHashScrollOffset() {
      const wrapper = navbarWrapper || getElement(SELECTORS.navbarWrapper);
      if (!wrapper) return CONSTANTS.HASH_SCROLL_EXTRA_OFFSET;

      const rect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      return (
        Math.max(0, Math.ceil(rect.height)) + CONSTANTS.HASH_SCROLL_EXTRA_OFFSET
      );
    }

    function scrollToHash(hash, updateHistory) {
      const target = getHashTarget(hash);
      if (!target) return false;

      const offset = getHashScrollOffset();
      const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
      const top = window.pageYOffset + rect.top - offset;

      try {
        if (updateHistory) {
          const nextUrl = `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${hash}`;
          history.replaceState(null, "", nextUrl);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        window.location.hash = hash;
      }

      try {
        window.scrollTo({
          top,
          behavior: "smooth",
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        window.scrollTo(0, top);
      }

      try {
        if (typeof target.focus === "function") {
          if (!target.hasAttribute("tabindex")) {
            target.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
          }
          target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }

      return true;
    }

    function resolveSamePageHashUrl(rawHref) {
      if (!rawHref) return null;

      if (isHashOnlyHref(rawHref)) {
        return safelyParseUrl(
          `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${rawHref.trim()}`,
        );
      }

      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
      if (!parsed || !parsed.hash) return null;

      const current = safelyParseUrl(window.location.href);
      if (!current) return null;

      const samePage =
        areSameNormalizedHostnames(parsed.hostname, current.hostname) &&
        parsed.pathname === current.pathname &&
        parsed.search === current.search;

      if (!samePage) return null;

      return parsed;
    }

    function initializeHashNavigation() {
      function handleHashClick(event) {
        const anchor =
          event.target && event.target.closest
            ? event.target.closest("a[href*='#']")
            : null;
        if (!anchor) return;
        if (anchor.closest(".w-tabs")) return;

        if (
          event.defaultPrevented ||
          event.button !== 0 ||
          event.metaKey ||
          event.ctrlKey ||
          event.shiftKey ||
          event.altKey
        )
          return;

        const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || "";
        const parsed = resolveSamePageHashUrl(rawHref);
        if (!parsed) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();

        scrollToHash(parsed.hash, true);
      }

      function handleInitialHash() {
        if (!window.location.hash) return;
        setTimeout(() => {
          scrollToHash(window.location.hash, false);
        }, 50);
        setTimeout(() => {
          scrollToHash(window.location.hash, false);
        }, 300);
      }

      document.addEventListener("click", handleHashClick, { capture: true });

      window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => {
        if (!window.location.hash) return;
        scrollToHash(window.location.hash, false);
      });

      window.addEventListener("load", handleInitialHash);
      handleInitialHash();
    }

    function initializeNavbar() {
      if (!primaryNavbar) return;
      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        const isOpen = primaryNavbar.hasAttribute("data-nav-menu-open");
        document.documentElement.classList.toggle("no-scroll", isOpen);
        if (navbarWrapper)
          navbarWrapper.classList.toggle("active-overlay", isOpen);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          primaryNavbar.style.height = isOpen ? `${window.innerHeight}px` : "";
        });
      });
      observer.observe(primaryNavbar, { attributes: true });
    }

    function initializeAgeGate() {

      if (!isHomepagePath()) return;
      if (shouldSkipAgeGateOnce()) return;

      if (
        getCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.teacher) ||
        getCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.parent)
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const section = getElement(SELECTORS.ageGateSection);
      if (!section) return;
      section.classList.add("show-gate");

      const btnPlay = getElement(SELECTORS.btnPlay);
      const btnEducators = getElement(SELECTORS.btnEducators);
      const btnParents = getElement(SELECTORS.btnParents);

      function handleAgeGateClick(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        section.classList.remove("show-gate");
        const id = event.currentTarget.id;

        if (id === "btn-prodigy-for-educators") {
          setCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.teacher, "true", 30);
          const nextUrl = appendLocaleParameter(
            mainEnBase ? `${mainEnBase}/teachers` : "/main-en/teachers",
          );
          const rewritten = rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(nextUrl);
          window.location.href = rewritten || nextUrl;
          return;
        }

        if (id === "btn-prodigy-for-parents") {
          setCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.parent, "true", 30);
          const nextUrl = appendLocaleParameter(
            mainEnBase ? `${mainEnBase}/parents` : "/main-en/parents",
          );
          const rewritten = rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(nextUrl);
          window.location.href = rewritten || nextUrl;
          return;
        }

        if (id === "btn-play-prodigy") {
          setCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.play, "true", 30);
          const nextUrl = appendLocaleParameter(event.currentTarget.href);
          const rewritten = rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(nextUrl);
          window.location.href = rewritten || nextUrl;
        }
      }

      addEvent(btnPlay, "click", handleAgeGateClick);
      addEvent(btnEducators, "click", handleAgeGateClick);
      addEvent(btnParents, "click", handleAgeGateClick);
    }

    function buildUrlWithParts(base, pathnamePart, search, hash) {
      const u = new URL(pathnamePart, base);
      if (search) u.search = search;
      if (hash) u.hash = hash;
      return u;
    }

    function computeRewrittenHref(anchor) {
      const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || "";
      if (!rawHref) return null;

      if (isHashOnlyHref(rawHref)) {
        return buildCurrentPageHashUrl(rawHref);
      }

      if (isSamePageHashLink(rawHref)) {
        const parsedSamePage = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
        if (!parsedSamePage) return rawHref;
        return `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${parsedSamePage.hash}`;
      }

      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
      if (!parsed) return null;

      const normalizedCurrentHostname = normalizeProdigyHostname(
        window.location.hostname,
      );
      const normalizedParsedHostname = normalizeProdigyHostname(
        parsed.hostname,
      );
      const isSameSiteAfterNormalization =
        normalizedParsedHostname === normalizedCurrentHostname;
      const isSsoHostAfterNormalization = ssoHostname
        ? normalizedParsedHostname === ssoHostname
        : false;
      const locale = getLocale();

      // Whitelist: Preserve SSO signup URLs as-is
      if (isSsoHostAfterNormalization && CONSTANTS.SSO_PRESERVE_PATHS_REGEX.test(parsed.pathname)) {
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
      }

      if (
        locale &&
        isSameSiteAfterNormalization &&
        isMembershipPath(parsed.pathname)
      ) {
        const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
          window.location.origin,
          parsed.pathname,
          parsed.search,
          parsed.hash,
        );
        const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
      }

      if (!domain || !ssoBase || !mainEnBase || !ssoHostname) {
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
      }

      for (const prefix of CONSTANTS.CONTENT_PREFIXES) {
        if (
          parsed.pathname.startsWith(prefix) &&
          isSameSiteAfterNormalization
        ) {
          const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
            window.location.origin,
            `${mainEnBase}${parsed.pathname}`,
            parsed.search,
            parsed.hash,
          );
          const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
          return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
        }
      }

      if (
        (parsed.pathname.startsWith("/teacher") ||
          parsed.pathname.startsWith("/parent")) &&
        (isSameSiteAfterNormalization || isSsoHostAfterNormalization)
      ) {
        if (TEACHER_EXCEPTION_SET.has(pathname))
          return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());

        if (CONSTANTS.SSO_PRESERVE_TEACHER_PARENT_ROUTES) {
          const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
            ssoBase,
            parsed.pathname,
            parsed.search || "?signup=true",
            parsed.hash,
          );
          if (!rebuilt.searchParams.has("signup"))
            rebuilt.searchParams.set("signup", "true");
          const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
          return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
        }

        const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
          ssoBase,
          "/signup",
          parsed.search || "?signup=true",
          parsed.hash,
        );
        const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
      }

      if (isSsoHostAfterNormalization) {
        const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
          ssoBase,
          parsed.pathname,
          parsed.search,
          parsed.hash,
        );
        const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
      }

      return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
    }

    function rewriteAnchor(anchor) {
      if (anchor.dataset[CONSTANTS.SSO_REWRITE_DATASET_KEY] === "1") return;

      const nextHref = computeRewrittenHref(anchor);
      if (!nextHref) return;

      const currentHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || "";
      if (currentHref !== nextHref) {
        anchor.setAttribute("href", nextHref);
      }

      anchor.dataset[CONSTANTS.SSO_REWRITE_DATASET_KEY] = "1";
    }

    function rewriteInternalLinksOnce() {
      getElements("a[href]").forEach(rewriteAnchor);
    }

    function observeAndRewriteInsertedLinks() {
      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const mutation of mutations) {
          for (const node of mutation.addedNodes) {
            if (!(node instanceof Element)) continue;

            if (node.tagName === "A" && node.hasAttribute("href")) {
              rewriteAnchor(node);
              continue;
            }

            const anchors = node.querySelectorAll("a[href]");
            for (const a of anchors) rewriteAnchor(a);
          }
        }
      });

      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    function initializeLogoBehavior() {
      const logo = getElement(SELECTORS.logo);
      addEvent(logo, "click", () => {
        sessionStorage.setItem(CONSTANTS.SKIP_AGE_GATE_SESSION_KEY, "true");
      });
    }

    function initializeAccordionHover() {
      const headers = getElements(SELECTORS.accordionHeaders);
      if (!headers.length) return;

      function syncHoverClass(header) {
        header.classList.toggle(
          "enable-hover",
          !header.classList.contains("w--open"),
        );
      }

      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const mutation of mutations) {
          if (mutation.target instanceof Element)
            syncHoverClass(mutation.target);
        }
      });

      headers.forEach((header) => {
        header.classList.add("enable-hover");
        addEvent(header, "mouseenter", () => {
          if (!header.classList.contains("w--open"))
            header.style.removeProperty("background-color");
        });
        addEvent(header, "mouseleave", () => {
          if (!header.classList.contains("w--open"))
            header.style.removeProperty("background-color");
        });
        observer.observe(header, {
          attributes: true,
          attributeFilter: ["class"],
        });
      });
    }

    function safelyMakeAbsoluteUrl(rawHref) {
      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref || "");
      if (!parsed) return null;
      const rewritten = rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
      return rewritten || parsed.toString();
    }

    function initializeButtonTracking() {
      const anchors = getElements(CONSTANTS.BUTTON_TRACKING.SELECTOR);
      if (!anchors.length) return;

      const pageSlug = (() => {
        const parts = window.location.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
        return parts.length ? parts[parts.length - 1] : "home";
      })();

      const slugify = (str) =>
        str
          .toLowerCase()
          .trim()
          .replace(/[\s\W-]+/g, "-")
          .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");

      anchors.forEach((anchor) => {
        addEvent(anchor, "click", (event) => {
          const text = (anchor.textContent || "").trim();
          if (!text) return;

          const buttonId = anchor.id || `${pageSlug}-button-${slugify(text)}`;
          const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href");
          if (!rawHref) return;

          if (isInPageHashLink(rawHref)) return;

          const parsedRaw = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
          if (parsedRaw && parsedRaw.hash) return;

          const finalUrl = safelyMakeAbsoluteUrl(rawHref);
          if (!finalUrl) return;

          if (
            window.analytics &&
            typeof window.analytics.track === "function"
          ) {
            event.preventDefault();

            let navigated = false;
            const go = () => {
              if (navigated) return;
              navigated = true;
              window.location.href = finalUrl;
            };

            try {
              window.analytics.track(
                CONSTANTS.BUTTON_TRACKING.EVENT_NAME,
                {
                  page: window.location.pathname,
                  button_text: text,
                  button_id: buttonId,
                },
                go,
              );
            } catch (error) {
              console.error(error);
              go();
              return;
            }

            setTimeout(go, CONSTANTS.BUTTON_TRACKING.TIMEOUT_MS);
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function initializeLanguageDropdownVisibility() {
      const desktop = getElement(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.DESKTOP);
      const mobile = getElement(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.MOBILE);
      // const ptElements = getElements("#pt")

      // if (!desktop && !mobile) return

      // if (!hostname.endsWith(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.VISIBLE_TLD)) {
      //   ptElements.forEach(el => el.classList.add(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.HIDDEN_CLASS))
      //   return
      // }

      if (desktop)
        desktop.classList.remove(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.HIDDEN_CLASS);
      if (mobile)
        mobile.classList.remove(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.HIDDEN_CLASS);

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeProdigyHeader)

function initializeProdigyHeader() {
  if (window.__PRODIGY_HEADER_INITIALIZED__) return
  window.__PRODIGY_HEADER_INITIALIZED__ = true

  const CONSTANTS = {
    LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY: "prodigyLanguage",
    LANGS: {
      EN: "EN",
      ES: "ES",
      PT: "PT"
    },
    PATH_PREFIXES: {
      ES: "/es",
      PT: "/pt",
      EN: "/main-en"
    }
  }

  function safelyGetNavigatorLanguage() {
    try {
      return navigator.language || navigator.userLanguage || ""
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return ""
    }
  }

  function safelyGetLocalStorageItem(key) {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(key)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return null
    }
  }

  function safelySetLocalStorageItem(key, value) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, value)
      return true
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return false
    }
  }

  function normalizeLang(value) {
    if (!value) return null
    const v = String(value).trim().toLowerCase()
    if (v.startsWith("en")) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.EN
    if (v.startsWith("es")) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES
    if (v.startsWith("pt")) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT
    return null
  }

  function safelyParseUrl(url) {
    try {
      return new URL(url, window.location.href)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return null
    }
  }

  function redirectTo(url) {
    try {
      window.location.replace(url)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      window.location.href = url
    }
  }

  function getSavedLang() {
    return normalizeLang(safelyGetLocalStorageItem(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY))
  }

  function setSavedLang(lang) {
    safelySetLocalStorageItem(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY, lang)
  }

  function getCurrentPathType(pathname) {
    const p = pathname || window.location.pathname || "/"
    if (p.startsWith(CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.ES)) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES
    if (p.startsWith(CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.PT)) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT
    return CONSTANTS.LANGS.EN
  }

  function stripKnownLanguagePrefixes(pathname) {
    const p = pathname || "/"
    const noEsPt = p.replace(/^\/(es|pt)(?=\/|$)/, "")
    const noMainEn = noEsPt.replace(/^\/main-en(?=\/|$)/, "")
    return noMainEn || "/"
  }

  function buildPathForLang(lang, pathname) {
    const stripped = stripKnownLanguagePrefixes(pathname)
    if (lang === CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES) return `${CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.ES}${stripped}`
    if (lang === CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT) return `${CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.PT}${stripped}`
    return `${CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.EN}${stripped}`
  }

  function getPreferredLang() {
    const saved = getSavedLang()
    if (saved) return saved

    const browser = normalizeLang(safelyGetNavigatorLanguage())
    if (browser === CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES
    if (browser === CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT

    return CONSTANTS.LANGS.EN
  }

  function autoRedirectIfNeeded() {
    const pathname = window.location.pathname || "/"

    const isExplicitEs = pathname.startsWith(CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.ES)
    const isExplicitPt = pathname.startsWith(CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.PT)

    if (isExplicitEs || isExplicitPt) return

    const preferred = getPreferredLang()
    const currentType = getCurrentPathType(pathname)

    if (preferred === currentType) return

    const nextPath = buildPathForLang(preferred, pathname)
    const nextUrl = `${nextPath}${window.location.search}${window.location.hash}`
    redirectTo(nextUrl)
  }

  function handleLanguageLinkClick(event) {
    const anchor = event.target && event.target.closest ? event.target.closest("a[hreflang]") : null
    if (!anchor) return

    const lang = normalizeLang(anchor.getAttribute("hreflang"))
    if (!lang) return

    event.preventDefault()
    setSavedLang(lang)

    const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || ""
    const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref)
    if (!parsed) return

    redirectTo(parsed.toString())
  }
}

<script>
  document.querySelectorAll('.testimonial-player').forEach((player) => {
    const video = player.querySelector('.testimonial-video');
    const playButton = player.querySelector('.play-button-testimonial');
    const playPauseBtn = player.querySelector('.playPauseBtn');
    const progressBar = player.querySelector('.testimonial-progress-bar');
    const progressFilled = player.querySelector('.progress-filled-testimonial');
    const controls = player.querySelector('.controls-testimonial');

    let previewMode = true; // loop 3s before play, muted until user presses play

    // Preview looping
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
      if (previewMode && video.currentTime >= 3) {
        video.pause();
        video.currentTime = 0;
        video.play();
      }
    });

    function startRealPlayback() {
      if (!previewMode) return;

      previewMode = false; // disables preview loop
      video.muted = false;
      video.currentTime = 0;
      video.play(); // starts real playback

      playButton.style.display = 'none';
      controls.style.opacity = 1;
      controls.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
    }

    function togglePlay() {
      if (previewMode) {
        startRealPlayback();
        return;
      }

      if (video.paused || video.ended) {
        video.play();
      } else {
        video.pause();
      }
    }

    function updateButton() {
      playPauseBtn.textContent = video.paused ? '▶' : '⏸';

      if (!previewMode) {
        playButton.style.display = video.paused ? 'flex' : 'none';
      }
    }

    function handleProgress() {
      if (!previewMode) {
        const percent = (video.currentTime / video.duration) * 100;
        progressFilled.style.width = percent + '%';
      }
    }

    function scrub(e) {
      if (previewMode) return;

      const scrubTime = (e.offsetX / progressBar.offsetWidth) * video.duration;
      video.currentTime = scrubTime;
    }

    playButton.addEventListener('click', togglePlay);
    playPauseBtn.addEventListener('click', togglePlay);

    video.addEventListener('play', updateButton);
    video.addEventListener('pause', updateButton);
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', handleProgress);

    progressBar.addEventListener('click', scrub);
  });
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeProdigySite);

  function initializeProdigySite() {
    if (window.__PRODIGY_SITE_INITIALIZED__) return;
    window.__PRODIGY_SITE_INITIALIZED__ = true;

    const CONSTANTS = {
      HOMEPAGES: [
        "/main-en",
        "/es",
        "/pt",
        "/main-en/home-a",
        "/main-en/home-b",
        "/main-en/home-2",
      ],
      TEACHER_EXCEPTIONS: [
        "/main-en/top-teachers",
        "/main-en/teachers-lp-m",
        "/main-en/teachers-lp",
        "/main-en/teacher-platform",
        "/main-en/web/teachers-m-bts",
        "/main-en/web/teachers-b-bts",
      ],
      CONTENT_PREFIXES: ["/blog", "/players", "/prodigy-newsroom"],
      AGE_GATE_COOKIES: {
        teacher: "teacherSelectedV2",
        parent: "parentSelectedV2",
        play: "playProdigyV2",
      },
      SKIP_AGE_GATE_SESSION_KEY: "skipAgeGate",
      SSO_PRESERVE_TEACHER_PARENT_ROUTES: false,
      SSO_REWRITE_DATASET_KEY: "prodigySsoRewritten",
      SSO_PRESERVE_PATHS_REGEX: /^\/(?:signup\/)?(teachers|parents)\/signup$/i,
      BUTTON_TRACKING: {
        EVENT_NAME: "Button Clicked",
        SELECTOR: "a.btn, a.w-button, a[data-wf--button--variant]",
        TIMEOUT_MS: 500,
      },
      LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN: {
        DESKTOP: ".dropdown-language-wrapper",
        MOBILE: ".dropdown-language-wrapper2",
        HIDDEN_CLASS: "hidden",
        VISIBLE_TLD: ".org",
      },
      SUGGESTED_LANG_PARAM: "suggested_lang",
      MEMBERSHIP_PATH_REGEX: /\/membership(\/math)?\/?$/i,
      HASH_SCROLL_EXTRA_OFFSET: 16,
    };

    const SELECTORS = {
      primaryNavbar: ".navbar--primary",
      navbarWrapper: ".navbar--wrapper",
      logo: ".navbar__logo",
      ageGateSection: ".section-age-gate",
      btnPlay: "#btn-play-prodigy",
      btnEducators: "#btn-prodigy-for-educators",
      btnParents: "#btn-prodigy-for-parents",
      accordionHeaders: ".accordion__header.w-dropdown-toggle",
    };

    const HOMEPAGE_SET = new Set(
      CONSTANTS.HOMEPAGES.map((p) => p.replace(/\/$/, "")),
    );
    const TEACHER_EXCEPTION_SET = new Set(
      CONSTANTS.TEACHER_EXCEPTIONS.map((p) => p.replace(/\/$/, "")),
    );

    function getElement(selector, scope = document) {
      return scope.querySelector(selector);
    }

    function getElements(selector, scope = document) {
      return Array.from(scope.querySelectorAll(selector));
    }

    function addEvent(element, eventName, handler) {
      if (element) element.addEventListener(eventName, handler);
    }

    function safelyParseUrl(url) {
      try {
        return new URL(url, window.location.href);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        return null;
      }
    }

    function setCookie(name, value, days) {
      try {
        const date = new Date();
        date.setTime(date.getTime() + days * 86400000);

        const base = `${encodeURIComponent(name)}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; expires=${date.toUTCString()}; path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
        const secure = window.location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";

        document.cookie = `${base}${secure}`;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }
    }

    function getCookie(name) {
      const encodedName = `${encodeURIComponent(name)}=`;
      const cookies = document.cookie.split(";");
      for (const c of cookies) {
        const cookie = c.trim();
        if (cookie.startsWith(encodedName)) {
          const rawValue = cookie.substring(encodedName.length);
          try {
            return decodeURIComponent(rawValue);
          } catch (error) {
            console.error(error);
            return rawValue;
          }
        }
      }
      return null;
    }

    const pathname = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "") || "/";
    const hostname = window.location.hostname;
    const domainMatch = hostname.match(/prodigygame\.(com|net|org)$/);
    const domainTld = domainMatch ? domainMatch[1] : null;
    const domain = domainTld ? `prodigygame.${domainTld}` : null;
    const ssoBase = domain ? `https://sso.${domain}` : null;
    const mainEnBase = domain ? `https://www.${domain}/main-en` : null;
    const ssoHostname = ssoBase
      ? (safelyParseUrl(ssoBase)?.hostname ?? null)
      : null;
    const primaryNavbar = getElement(SELECTORS.primaryNavbar);
    const navbarWrapper = getElement(SELECTORS.navbarWrapper);

    function getLocale() {
      if (pathname.startsWith("/es")) return "es";
      if (pathname.startsWith("/pt")) return "pt";
      return null;
    }

    function isMembershipPath(path) {
      return CONSTANTS.MEMBERSHIP_PATH_REGEX.test(path || "");
    }

    function appendLocaleParameter(url) {
      const locale = getLocale();
      if (!locale) return url;

      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(url);
      if (!parsed) return url;

      const key = CONSTANTS.SUGGESTED_LANG_PARAM;
      const shouldForce = isMembershipPath(parsed.pathname);

      if (shouldForce) {
        parsed.searchParams.set(key, locale);
        return parsed.toString();
      }

      if (!parsed.searchParams.has(key)) {
        parsed.searchParams.set(key, locale);
      }

      return parsed.toString();
    }

    function isHomepagePath() {
      return HOMEPAGE_SET.has(pathname);
    }

    function shouldSkipAgeGateOnce() {
      const key = CONSTANTS.SKIP_AGE_GATE_SESSION_KEY;
      if (!sessionStorage.getItem(key)) return false;
      sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
      return true;
    }

    function normalizeProdigyHostname(host) {
      if (!domainTld) return host;
      const match = host.match(/^(.*\.)?prodigygame\.(com|org|net)$/i);
      if (!match) return host;
      const subdomain = match[1] || "";
      return `${subdomain}prodigygame.${domainTld}`;
    }

    function rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(url) {
      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(url);
      if (!parsed) return null;
      const nextHostname = normalizeProdigyHostname(parsed.hostname);
      if (nextHostname !== parsed.hostname) {
        parsed.hostname = nextHostname;
      }
      return parsed.toString();
    }

    function isHashOnlyHref(rawHref) {
      if (!rawHref) return false;
      const trimmed = rawHref.trim();
      return trimmed.startsWith("#") && trimmed.length > 1;
    }

    function buildCurrentPageHashUrl(rawHref) {
      if (!isHashOnlyHref(rawHref)) return null;
      return `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${rawHref.trim()}`;
    }

    function areSameNormalizedHostnames(left, right) {
      return normalizeProdigyHostname(left) === normalizeProdigyHostname(right);
    }

    function isSamePageHashLink(rawHref) {
      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
      if (!parsed || !parsed.hash) return false;

      const current = safelyParseUrl(window.location.href);
      if (!current) return false;

      return (
        areSameNormalizedHostnames(parsed.hostname, current.hostname) &&
        parsed.pathname === current.pathname &&
        parsed.search === current.search
      );
    }

    function isInPageHashLink(rawHref) {
      return isHashOnlyHref(rawHref) || isSamePageHashLink(rawHref);
    }

    function getHashTarget(hash) {
      if (!hash) return null;

      const rawId = hash.replace(/^#/, "");
      if (!rawId) return null;

      let decodedId = rawId;
      try {
        decodedId = decodeURIComponent(rawId);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }

      const byId = document.getElementById(decodedId);
      if (byId) return byId;

      try {
        const escaped =
          window.CSS && typeof window.CSS.escape === "function"
            ? window.CSS.escape(decodedId)
            : decodedId.replace(/["\\]/g, "\\$&");
        const named = document.querySelector(`[name="${escaped}"]`);
        if (named) return named;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }

      return null;
    }

    function getHashScrollOffset() {
      const wrapper = navbarWrapper || getElement(SELECTORS.navbarWrapper);
      if (!wrapper) return CONSTANTS.HASH_SCROLL_EXTRA_OFFSET;

      const rect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      return (
        Math.max(0, Math.ceil(rect.height)) + CONSTANTS.HASH_SCROLL_EXTRA_OFFSET
      );
    }

    function scrollToHash(hash, updateHistory) {
      const target = getHashTarget(hash);
      if (!target) return false;

      const offset = getHashScrollOffset();
      const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
      const top = window.pageYOffset + rect.top - offset;

      try {
        if (updateHistory) {
          const nextUrl = `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${hash}`;
          history.replaceState(null, "", nextUrl);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        window.location.hash = hash;
      }

      try {
        window.scrollTo({
          top,
          behavior: "smooth",
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        window.scrollTo(0, top);
      }

      try {
        if (typeof target.focus === "function") {
          if (!target.hasAttribute("tabindex")) {
            target.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
          }
          target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }

      return true;
    }

    function resolveSamePageHashUrl(rawHref) {
      if (!rawHref) return null;

      if (isHashOnlyHref(rawHref)) {
        return safelyParseUrl(
          `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${rawHref.trim()}`,
        );
      }

      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
      if (!parsed || !parsed.hash) return null;

      const current = safelyParseUrl(window.location.href);
      if (!current) return null;

      const samePage =
        areSameNormalizedHostnames(parsed.hostname, current.hostname) &&
        parsed.pathname === current.pathname &&
        parsed.search === current.search;

      if (!samePage) return null;

      return parsed;
    }

    function initializeHashNavigation() {
      function handleHashClick(event) {
        const anchor =
          event.target && event.target.closest
            ? event.target.closest("a[href*='#']")
            : null;
        if (!anchor) return;
        if (anchor.closest(".w-tabs")) return;

        if (
          event.defaultPrevented ||
          event.button !== 0 ||
          event.metaKey ||
          event.ctrlKey ||
          event.shiftKey ||
          event.altKey
        )
          return;

        const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || "";
        const parsed = resolveSamePageHashUrl(rawHref);
        if (!parsed) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();

        scrollToHash(parsed.hash, true);
      }

      function handleInitialHash() {
        if (!window.location.hash) return;
        setTimeout(() => {
          scrollToHash(window.location.hash, false);
        }, 50);
        setTimeout(() => {
          scrollToHash(window.location.hash, false);
        }, 300);
      }

      document.addEventListener("click", handleHashClick, { capture: true });

      window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => {
        if (!window.location.hash) return;
        scrollToHash(window.location.hash, false);
      });

      window.addEventListener("load", handleInitialHash);
      handleInitialHash();
    }

    function initializeNavbar() {
      if (!primaryNavbar) return;
      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        const isOpen = primaryNavbar.hasAttribute("data-nav-menu-open");
        document.documentElement.classList.toggle("no-scroll", isOpen);
        if (navbarWrapper)
          navbarWrapper.classList.toggle("active-overlay", isOpen);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          primaryNavbar.style.height = isOpen ? `${window.innerHeight}px` : "";
        });
      });
      observer.observe(primaryNavbar, { attributes: true });
    }

    function initializeAgeGate() {

      if (!isHomepagePath()) return;
      if (shouldSkipAgeGateOnce()) return;

      if (
        getCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.teacher) ||
        getCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.parent)
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const section = getElement(SELECTORS.ageGateSection);
      if (!section) return;
      section.classList.add("show-gate");

      const btnPlay = getElement(SELECTORS.btnPlay);
      const btnEducators = getElement(SELECTORS.btnEducators);
      const btnParents = getElement(SELECTORS.btnParents);

      function handleAgeGateClick(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        section.classList.remove("show-gate");
        const id = event.currentTarget.id;

        if (id === "btn-prodigy-for-educators") {
          setCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.teacher, "true", 30);
          const nextUrl = appendLocaleParameter(
            mainEnBase ? `${mainEnBase}/teachers` : "/main-en/teachers",
          );
          const rewritten = rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(nextUrl);
          window.location.href = rewritten || nextUrl;
          return;
        }

        if (id === "btn-prodigy-for-parents") {
          setCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.parent, "true", 30);
          const nextUrl = appendLocaleParameter(
            mainEnBase ? `${mainEnBase}/parents` : "/main-en/parents",
          );
          const rewritten = rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(nextUrl);
          window.location.href = rewritten || nextUrl;
          return;
        }

        if (id === "btn-play-prodigy") {
          setCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.play, "true", 30);
          const nextUrl = appendLocaleParameter(event.currentTarget.href);
          const rewritten = rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(nextUrl);
          window.location.href = rewritten || nextUrl;
        }
      }

      addEvent(btnPlay, "click", handleAgeGateClick);
      addEvent(btnEducators, "click", handleAgeGateClick);
      addEvent(btnParents, "click", handleAgeGateClick);
    }

    function buildUrlWithParts(base, pathnamePart, search, hash) {
      const u = new URL(pathnamePart, base);
      if (search) u.search = search;
      if (hash) u.hash = hash;
      return u;
    }

    function computeRewrittenHref(anchor) {
      const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || "";
      if (!rawHref) return null;

      if (isHashOnlyHref(rawHref)) {
        return buildCurrentPageHashUrl(rawHref);
      }

      if (isSamePageHashLink(rawHref)) {
        const parsedSamePage = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
        if (!parsedSamePage) return rawHref;
        return `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${parsedSamePage.hash}`;
      }

      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
      if (!parsed) return null;

      const normalizedCurrentHostname = normalizeProdigyHostname(
        window.location.hostname,
      );
      const normalizedParsedHostname = normalizeProdigyHostname(
        parsed.hostname,
      );
      const isSameSiteAfterNormalization =
        normalizedParsedHostname === normalizedCurrentHostname;
      const isSsoHostAfterNormalization = ssoHostname
        ? normalizedParsedHostname === ssoHostname
        : false;
      const locale = getLocale();

      // Whitelist: Preserve SSO signup URLs as-is
      if (isSsoHostAfterNormalization && CONSTANTS.SSO_PRESERVE_PATHS_REGEX.test(parsed.pathname)) {
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
      }

      if (
        locale &&
        isSameSiteAfterNormalization &&
        isMembershipPath(parsed.pathname)
      ) {
        const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
          window.location.origin,
          parsed.pathname,
          parsed.search,
          parsed.hash,
        );
        const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
      }

      if (!domain || !ssoBase || !mainEnBase || !ssoHostname) {
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
      }

      for (const prefix of CONSTANTS.CONTENT_PREFIXES) {
        if (
          parsed.pathname.startsWith(prefix) &&
          isSameSiteAfterNormalization
        ) {
          const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
            window.location.origin,
            `${mainEnBase}${parsed.pathname}`,
            parsed.search,
            parsed.hash,
          );
          const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
          return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
        }
      }

      if (
        (parsed.pathname.startsWith("/teacher") ||
          parsed.pathname.startsWith("/parent")) &&
        (isSameSiteAfterNormalization || isSsoHostAfterNormalization)
      ) {
        if (TEACHER_EXCEPTION_SET.has(pathname))
          return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());

        if (CONSTANTS.SSO_PRESERVE_TEACHER_PARENT_ROUTES) {
          const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
            ssoBase,
            parsed.pathname,
            parsed.search || "?signup=true",
            parsed.hash,
          );
          if (!rebuilt.searchParams.has("signup"))
            rebuilt.searchParams.set("signup", "true");
          const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
          return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
        }

        const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
          ssoBase,
          "/signup",
          parsed.search || "?signup=true",
          parsed.hash,
        );
        const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
      }

      if (isSsoHostAfterNormalization) {
        const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
          ssoBase,
          parsed.pathname,
          parsed.search,
          parsed.hash,
        );
        const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
      }

      return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
    }

    function rewriteAnchor(anchor) {
      if (anchor.dataset[CONSTANTS.SSO_REWRITE_DATASET_KEY] === "1") return;

      const nextHref = computeRewrittenHref(anchor);
      if (!nextHref) return;

      const currentHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || "";
      if (currentHref !== nextHref) {
        anchor.setAttribute("href", nextHref);
      }

      anchor.dataset[CONSTANTS.SSO_REWRITE_DATASET_KEY] = "1";
    }

    function rewriteInternalLinksOnce() {
      getElements("a[href]").forEach(rewriteAnchor);
    }

    function observeAndRewriteInsertedLinks() {
      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const mutation of mutations) {
          for (const node of mutation.addedNodes) {
            if (!(node instanceof Element)) continue;

            if (node.tagName === "A" && node.hasAttribute("href")) {
              rewriteAnchor(node);
              continue;
            }

            const anchors = node.querySelectorAll("a[href]");
            for (const a of anchors) rewriteAnchor(a);
          }
        }
      });

      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    function initializeLogoBehavior() {
      const logo = getElement(SELECTORS.logo);
      addEvent(logo, "click", () => {
        sessionStorage.setItem(CONSTANTS.SKIP_AGE_GATE_SESSION_KEY, "true");
      });
    }

    function initializeAccordionHover() {
      const headers = getElements(SELECTORS.accordionHeaders);
      if (!headers.length) return;

      function syncHoverClass(header) {
        header.classList.toggle(
          "enable-hover",
          !header.classList.contains("w--open"),
        );
      }

      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const mutation of mutations) {
          if (mutation.target instanceof Element)
            syncHoverClass(mutation.target);
        }
      });

      headers.forEach((header) => {
        header.classList.add("enable-hover");
        addEvent(header, "mouseenter", () => {
          if (!header.classList.contains("w--open"))
            header.style.removeProperty("background-color");
        });
        addEvent(header, "mouseleave", () => {
          if (!header.classList.contains("w--open"))
            header.style.removeProperty("background-color");
        });
        observer.observe(header, {
          attributes: true,
          attributeFilter: ["class"],
        });

    function safelyMakeAbsoluteUrl(rawHref) {

    }

    function initializeButtonTracking() {
      const anchors = getElements(CONSTANTS.BUTTON_TRACKING.SELECTOR);
      if (!anchors.length) return;

      const pageSlug = (() => {
        const parts = window.location.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
        return parts.length ? parts[parts.length - 1] : "home";
      })();

      const slugify = (str) =>
        str
          .toLowerCase()
          .trim()
          .replace(/[\s\W-]+/g, "-")
          .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");

      anchors.forEach((anchor) => {
        addEvent(anchor, "click", (event) => {
          const text = (anchor.textContent || "").trim();
          if (!text) return;

          const buttonId = anchor.id || `${pageSlug}-button-${slugify(text)}`;
          const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href");
          if (!rawHref) return;

          if (isInPageHashLink(rawHref)) return;

          const parsedRaw = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
          if (parsedRaw && parsedRaw.hash) return;

          const finalUrl = safelyMakeAbsoluteUrl(rawHref);
          if (!finalUrl) return;

          if (
            window.analytics &&
            typeof window.analytics.track === "function"
          ) {
            event.preventDefault();

            let navigated = false;
            const go = () => {
              if (navigated) return;
              navigated = true;
              window.location.href = finalUrl;
            };

            try {
              window.analytics.track(
                CONSTANTS.BUTTON_TRACKING.EVENT_NAME,
                {
                  page: window.location.pathname,
                  button_text: text,
                  button_id: buttonId,
                },
                go,
              );
            } catch (error) {
              console.error(error);
              go();
              return;
            }

            setTimeout(go, CONSTANTS.BUTTON_TRACKING.TIMEOUT_MS);
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function initializeLanguageDropdownVisibility() {
      const desktop = getElement(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.DESKTOP);
      const mobile = getElement(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.MOBILE);

      // if (!desktop && !mobile) return

      //   ptElements.forEach(el => el.classList.add(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.HIDDEN_CLASS))
      //   return
      // }

      if (desktop)
        desktop.classList.remove(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.HIDDEN_CLASS);
      if (mobile)
        mobile.classList.remove(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.HIDDEN_CLASS);
    }

      //   }
      // });

      // var fakeDropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('#w-dropdown-toggle-2, #w-dropdown-toggle-14');
      // fakeDropdowns.forEach(function(el) {
      //   el.removeAttribute('role');
      //   el.removeAttribute('tabindex');
      //   el.removeAttribute('aria-haspopup');
      //   el.removeAttribute('aria-expanded');
      //   el.removeAttribute('aria-controls');

      //   el.style.pointerEvents = 'none';

      //   var link = el.querySelector('a');
      //   if (link) {
      //     link.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
      //   }
      // });

      // var wrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-hidden-default > div:first-child');
      // wrappers.forEach(function(el) {
      //   if (!el.closest('header, main, footer, nav')) {
      //     el.setAttribute('role', 'presentation');
      //   }
      // });
      var banners = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".mega-nav.w-nav, .mega-nav-mobile.w-nav",
      );
      banners.forEach(function (el) {
        el.removeAttribute("role");
      });

      var nestedButtons = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".toggle-link-block.mega-menu-nav-link",
      );
      nestedButtons.forEach(function (el) {
        el.removeAttribute("role");
        el.removeAttribute("tabindex");
      });

      var navs = document.querySelectorAll('.w-nav-menu[role="navigation"]');
      navs.forEach(function (nav, index) {
        if (!nav.getAttribute("aria-label")) {

      links.forEach(function (el) {
        el.style.color = "#000000";

    initializeNavbar();
    initializeAgeGate();

    observeAndRewriteInsertedLinks();

    rewrittenLinks.forEach(function (link) {
      const text = link.innerText.trim();
      const hasImage = link.querySelector('img[alt]');

      if (!text && !hasImage && !link.getAttribute('aria-label')) {
        const href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';

        if (href.includes('prodigy-math-research-clifton-new-jersey')) {
          link.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Read research: Prodigy Math results in Clifton, New Jersey');
        } else if (href.includes('prodigy-math')) {
          link.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Prodigy Math Game');
        } else if (href.includes('math-curriculum-standards')) {
          link.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Math Curriculum Standard');
        } else if (href.includes('prodigy-english')) {
          link.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Prodigy English');
        } else {
          const segment = href.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop();
          if (segment) {
            const label = segment.replace(/-/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
            link.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
          }
        }

        const emptyContent = link.querySelector('strong');
        if (emptyContent) {
          emptyContent.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        }
      }
    });
  });
</script>

function initializeProdigyHeader() {
  if (window.__PRODIGY_HEADER_INITIALIZED__) return
  window.__PRODIGY_HEADER_INITIALIZED__ = true

  const CONSTANTS = {
    LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY: "prodigyLanguage",
    LANGS: {
      EN: "EN",
      ES: "ES",
      PT: "PT"
    },
    PATH_PREFIXES: {
      ES: "/es",
      PT: "/pt",
      EN: "/main-en"
    }
  }

  function safelyGetNavigatorLanguage() {
    try {
      return navigator.language || navigator.userLanguage || ""
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return ""
    }
  }

  function safelyGetLocalStorageItem(key) {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(key)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return null
    }
  }

  function safelySetLocalStorageItem(key, value) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, value)
      return true
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return false
    }
  }

  function normalizeLang(value) {
    if (!value) return null

<script>
  document.querySelectorAll('.testimonial-player').forEach((player) => {
    const video = player.querySelector('.testimonial-video');
    const playButton = player.querySelector('.play-button-testimonial');
    const playPauseBtn = player.querySelector('.playPauseBtn');
    const progressBar = player.querySelector('.testimonial-progress-bar');
    const progressFilled = player.querySelector('.progress-filled-testimonial');
    const controls = player.querySelector('.controls-testimonial');

    let previewMode = true; // loop 3s before play, muted until user presses play

    // Preview looping
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
      if (previewMode && video.currentTime >= 3) {
        video.pause();
        video.currentTime = 0;
        video.play();
      }
    });

    function startRealPlayback() {
      if (!previewMode) return;

      previewMode = false; // disables preview loop
      video.muted = false;
      video.currentTime = 0;
      video.play(); // starts real playback

      playButton.style.display = 'none';
      controls.style.opacity = 1;
      controls.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
    }

    function togglePlay() {
      if (previewMode) {
        startRealPlayback();
        return;
      }

      if (video.paused || video.ended) {
        video.play();
      } else {
        video.pause();
      }
    }

    function updateButton() {
      playPauseBtn.textContent = video.paused ? '▶' : '⏸';

      if (!previewMode) {
        playButton.style.display = video.paused ? 'flex' : 'none';
      }
    }

    function handleProgress() {
      if (!previewMode) {
        const percent = (video.currentTime / video.duration) * 100;
        progressFilled.style.width = percent + '%';
      }
    }

    function scrub(e) {
      if (previewMode) return;

      const scrubTime = (e.offsetX / progressBar.offsetWidth) * video.duration;
      video.currentTime = scrubTime;
    }

    playButton.addEventListener('click', togglePlay);
    playPauseBtn.addEventListener('click', togglePlay);

    video.addEventListener('play', updateButton);
    video.addEventListener('pause', updateButton);
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', handleProgress);

    progressBar.addEventListener('click', scrub);
  });
</script>

    );
    const TEACHER_EXCEPTION_SET = new Set(

    );

    function getElement(selector, scope = document) {
      return scope.querySelector(selector);
    }

    function getElements(selector, scope = document) {

    }

    function addEvent(element, eventName, handler) {

    }

    function safelyParseUrl(url) {
      try {
        return new URL(url, window.location.href);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        return null;
      }
    }

    function setCookie(name, value, days) {
      try {
        const date = new Date();
        date.setTime(date.getTime() + days * 86400000);

        const base = `${encodeURIComponent(name)}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; expires=${date.toUTCString()}; path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
        const secure = window.location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";

        document.cookie = `${base}${secure}`;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }
    }

    function getCookie(name) {
      const encodedName = `${encodeURIComponent(name)}=`;
      const cookies = document.cookie.split(";");
      for (const c of cookies) {
        const cookie = c.trim();
        if (cookie.startsWith(encodedName)) {
          const rawValue = cookie.substring(encodedName.length);
          try {
            return decodeURIComponent(rawValue);
          } catch (error) {
            console.error(error);
            return rawValue;
          }
        }
      }
      return null;
    }

    const pathname = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "") || "/";
    const hostname = window.location.hostname;
    const domainMatch = hostname.match(/prodigygame\.(com|net|org)$/);
    const domainTld = domainMatch ? domainMatch[1] : null;
    const domain = domainTld ? `prodigygame.${domainTld}` : null;
    const ssoBase = domain ? `https://sso.${domain}` : null;
    const mainEnBase = domain ? `https://www.${domain}/main-en` : null;
    const ssoHostname = ssoBase
      ? (safelyParseUrl(ssoBase)?.hostname ?? null)
      : null;
    const primaryNavbar = getElement(SELECTORS.primaryNavbar);
    const navbarWrapper = getElement(SELECTORS.navbarWrapper);

    function getLocale() {
      if (pathname.startsWith("/es")) return "es";

    function isMembershipPath(path) {

    function appendLocaleParameter(url) {

      if (!locale) return url;

      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(url);
      if (!parsed) return url;

      const key = CONSTANTS.SUGGESTED_LANG_PARAM;

    function isHomepagePath() {

    function shouldSkipAgeGateOnce() {

    function normalizeProdigyHostname(host) {
      if (!domainTld) return host;
      const match = host.match(/^(.*\.)?prodigygame\.(com|org|net)$/i);
      if (!match) return host;
      const subdomain = match[1] || "";
      return `${subdomain}prodigygame.${domainTld}`;
