    function rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(url) {
      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(url);
      if (!parsed) return null;
      const nextHostname = normalizeProdigyHostname(parsed.hostname);
      if (nextHostname !== parsed.hostname) {
        parsed.hostname = nextHostname;
      }
      return parsed.toString();
    }

    function isHashOnlyHref(rawHref) {
      if (!rawHref) return false;
      const trimmed = rawHref.trim();
      return trimmed.startsWith("#") && trimmed.length > 1;
    }

    function buildCurrentPageHashUrl(rawHref) {
      if (!isHashOnlyHref(rawHref)) return null;
      return `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${rawHref.trim()}`;
    }

    function areSameNormalizedHostnames(left, right) {
      return normalizeProdigyHostname(left) === normalizeProdigyHostname(right);
    }

    function isSamePageHashLink(rawHref) {
      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
      if (!parsed || !parsed.hash) return false;

      const current = safelyParseUrl(window.location.href);
      if (!current) return false;

      return (
        areSameNormalizedHostnames(parsed.hostname, current.hostname) &&
        parsed.pathname === current.pathname &&
        parsed.search === current.search
      );
    }

    function isInPageHashLink(rawHref) {
      return isHashOnlyHref(rawHref) || isSamePageHashLink(rawHref);
    }

    function getHashTarget(hash) {
      if (!hash) return null;

      const rawId = hash.replace(/^#/, "");
      if (!rawId) return null;

      let decodedId = rawId;
      try {
        decodedId = decodeURIComponent(rawId);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }

      const byId = document.getElementById(decodedId);
      if (byId) return byId;

      try {
        const escaped =
          window.CSS && typeof window.CSS.escape === "function"
            ? window.CSS.escape(decodedId)
            : decodedId.replace(/["\\]/g, "\\$&");
        const named = document.querySelector(`[name="${escaped}"]`);
        if (named) return named;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }

      return null;
    }

    function getHashScrollOffset() {
      const wrapper = navbarWrapper || getElement(SELECTORS.navbarWrapper);
      if (!wrapper) return CONSTANTS.HASH_SCROLL_EXTRA_OFFSET;

      const rect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      return (
        Math.max(0, Math.ceil(rect.height)) + CONSTANTS.HASH_SCROLL_EXTRA_OFFSET
      );
    }

    function scrollToHash(hash, updateHistory) {
      const target = getHashTarget(hash);
      if (!target) return false;

      const offset = getHashScrollOffset();
      const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
      const top = window.pageYOffset + rect.top - offset;

      try {
        if (updateHistory) {
          const nextUrl = `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${hash}`;
          history.replaceState(null, "", nextUrl);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        window.location.hash = hash;
      }

      try {
        window.scrollTo({
          top,
          behavior: "smooth",
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        window.scrollTo(0, top);
      }

      try {
        if (typeof target.focus === "function") {
          if (!target.hasAttribute("tabindex")) {
            target.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
          }
          target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }

      return true;
    }

    function resolveSamePageHashUrl(rawHref) {
      if (!rawHref) return null;

      if (isHashOnlyHref(rawHref)) {
        return safelyParseUrl(
          `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${rawHref.trim()}`,

      }

      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
      if (!parsed || !parsed.hash) return null;

      const current = safelyParseUrl(window.location.href);
      if (!current) return null;

      const samePage =
        areSameNormalizedHostnames(parsed.hostname, current.hostname) &&
        parsed.pathname === current.pathname &&
        parsed.search === current.search;

      if (!samePage) return null;

      return parsed;
    }

    function initializeHashNavigation() {
      function handleHashClick(event) {
        const anchor =
          event.target && event.target.closest
            ? event.target.closest("a[href*='#']")
            : null;
        if (!anchor) return;
        if (anchor.closest(".w-tabs")) return;

        if (
          event.defaultPrevented ||
          event.button !== 0 ||
          event.metaKey ||
          event.ctrlKey ||
          event.shiftKey ||
          event.altKey
        )
          return;

        const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || "";
        const parsed = resolveSamePageHashUrl(rawHref);
        if (!parsed) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();

        scrollToHash(parsed.hash, true);
      }

      function handleInitialHash() {
        if (!window.location.hash) return;
        setTimeout(() => {
          scrollToHash(window.location.hash, false);
        }, 50);
        setTimeout(() => {
          scrollToHash(window.location.hash, false);
        }, 300);
      }

      document.addEventListener("click", handleHashClick, { capture: true });

      window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => {
        if (!window.location.hash) return;
        scrollToHash(window.location.hash, false);
      });

      window.addEventListener("load", handleInitialHash);
      handleInitialHash();

      if (!primaryNavbar) return;
      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        const isOpen = primaryNavbar.hasAttribute("data-nav-menu-open");
        document.documentElement.classList.toggle("no-scroll", isOpen);
        if (navbarWrapper)
          navbarWrapper.classList.toggle("active-overlay", isOpen);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          primaryNavbar.style.height = isOpen ? `${window.innerHeight}px` : "";
        });
      });
      observer.observe(primaryNavbar, { attributes: true });
    }

    function initializeAgeGate() {

      if (!isHomepagePath()) return;
      if (shouldSkipAgeGateOnce()) return;

      if (
        getCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.teacher) ||
        getCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.parent)
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const section = getElement(SELECTORS.ageGateSection);
      if (!section) return;
      section.classList.add("show-gate");

      const btnPlay = getElement(SELECTORS.btnPlay);
      const btnEducators = getElement(SELECTORS.btnEducators);
      const btnParents = getElement(SELECTORS.btnParents);

      function handleAgeGateClick(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        section.classList.remove("show-gate");
        const id = event.currentTarget.id;

        if (id === "btn-prodigy-for-educators") {
          setCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.teacher, "true", 30);
          const nextUrl = appendLocaleParameter(
            mainEnBase ? `${mainEnBase}/teachers` : "/main-en/teachers",
          );
          const rewritten = rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(nextUrl);
          window.location.href = rewritten || nextUrl;
          return;
        }

        if (id === "btn-prodigy-for-parents") {
          setCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.parent, "true", 30);
          const nextUrl = appendLocaleParameter(
            mainEnBase ? `${mainEnBase}/parents` : "/main-en/parents",
          );
          const rewritten = rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(nextUrl);
          window.location.href = rewritten || nextUrl;
          return;
        }

        if (id === "btn-play-prodigy") {
          setCookie(CONSTANTS.AGE_GATE_COOKIES.play, "true", 30);
          const nextUrl = appendLocaleParameter(event.currentTarget.href);
          const rewritten = rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(nextUrl);
          window.location.href = rewritten || nextUrl;
        }
      }

      addEvent(btnPlay, "click", handleAgeGateClick);
      addEvent(btnEducators, "click", handleAgeGateClick);
      addEvent(btnParents, "click", handleAgeGateClick);
    }

    function buildUrlWithParts(base, pathnamePart, search, hash) {
      const u = new URL(pathnamePart, base);
      if (search) u.search = search;
      if (hash) u.hash = hash;
      return u;
    }

    function computeRewrittenHref(anchor) {
      const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || "";
      if (!rawHref) return null;

      if (isHashOnlyHref(rawHref)) {
        return buildCurrentPageHashUrl(rawHref);
      }

      if (isSamePageHashLink(rawHref)) {
        const parsedSamePage = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
        if (!parsedSamePage) return rawHref;
        return `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${parsedSamePage.hash}`;
      }

      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
      if (!parsed) return null;

      const normalizedCurrentHostname = normalizeProdigyHostname(
        window.location.hostname,
      );
      const normalizedParsedHostname = normalizeProdigyHostname(
        parsed.hostname,
      );
      const isSameSiteAfterNormalization =
        normalizedParsedHostname === normalizedCurrentHostname;
      const isSsoHostAfterNormalization = ssoHostname
        ? normalizedParsedHostname === ssoHostname
        : false;
      const locale = getLocale();

      // Whitelist: Preserve SSO signup URLs as-is
      if (isSsoHostAfterNormalization && CONSTANTS.SSO_PRESERVE_PATHS_REGEX.test(parsed.pathname)) {
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
      }

      if (
        locale &&
        isSameSiteAfterNormalization &&
        isMembershipPath(parsed.pathname)
      ) {
        const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
          window.location.origin,
          parsed.pathname,
          parsed.search,
          parsed.hash,
        );
        const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
      }

      if (!domain || !ssoBase || !mainEnBase || !ssoHostname) {
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
      }

      for (const prefix of CONSTANTS.CONTENT_PREFIXES) {
        if (
          parsed.pathname.startsWith(prefix) &&
          isSameSiteAfterNormalization
        ) {
          const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
            window.location.origin,
            `${mainEnBase}${parsed.pathname}`,
            parsed.search,
            parsed.hash,
          );
          const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
          return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
        }
      }

      if (
        (parsed.pathname.startsWith("/teacher") ||
          parsed.pathname.startsWith("/parent")) &&
        (isSameSiteAfterNormalization || isSsoHostAfterNormalization)
      ) {
        if (TEACHER_EXCEPTION_SET.has(pathname))
          return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());

        if (CONSTANTS.SSO_PRESERVE_TEACHER_PARENT_ROUTES) {
          const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
            ssoBase,
            parsed.pathname,
            parsed.search || "?signup=true",
            parsed.hash,
          );
          if (!rebuilt.searchParams.has("signup"))
            rebuilt.searchParams.set("signup", "true");
          const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
          return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
        }

        const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
          ssoBase,
          "/signup",
          parsed.search || "?signup=true",
          parsed.hash,
        );
        const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
      }

      if (isSsoHostAfterNormalization) {
        const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
          ssoBase,
          parsed.pathname,
          parsed.search,
          parsed.hash,
        );
        const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
      }

      return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
    }

    function rewriteAnchor(anchor) {
      if (anchor.dataset[CONSTANTS.SSO_REWRITE_DATASET_KEY] === "1") return;

      const nextHref = computeRewrittenHref(anchor);
      if (!nextHref) return;

      const currentHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || "";
      if (currentHref !== nextHref) {
        anchor.setAttribute("href", nextHref);
      }

      anchor.dataset[CONSTANTS.SSO_REWRITE_DATASET_KEY] = "1";
    }

    function rewriteInternalLinksOnce() {
      getElements("a[href]").forEach(rewriteAnchor);
    }

    function observeAndRewriteInsertedLinks() {
      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const mutation of mutations) {
          for (const node of mutation.addedNodes) {
            if (!(node instanceof Element)) continue;

            if (node.tagName === "A" && node.hasAttribute("href")) {
              rewriteAnchor(node);
              continue;
            }

            const anchors = node.querySelectorAll("a[href]");
            for (const a of anchors) rewriteAnchor(a);
          }
        }
      });

      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    function initializeLogoBehavior() {
      const logo = getElement(SELECTORS.logo);
      addEvent(logo, "click", () => {
        sessionStorage.setItem(CONSTANTS.SKIP_AGE_GATE_SESSION_KEY, "true");
      });
    }

    function initializeAccordionHover() {
      const headers = getElements(SELECTORS.accordionHeaders);
      if (!headers.length) return;

      function syncHoverClass(header) {
        header.classList.toggle(
          "enable-hover",
          !header.classList.contains("w--open"),
        );
      }

      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const mutation of mutations) {
          if (mutation.target instanceof Element)
            syncHoverClass(mutation.target);
        }
      });

      headers.forEach((header) => {
        header.classList.add("enable-hover");
        addEvent(header, "mouseenter", () => {
          if (!header.classList.contains("w--open"))
            header.style.removeProperty("background-color");
        });
        addEvent(header, "mouseleave", () => {
          if (!header.classList.contains("w--open"))
            header.style.removeProperty("background-color");
        });
        observer.observe(header, {
          attributes: true,
          attributeFilter: ["class"],
        });
      });
    }

    function safelyMakeAbsoluteUrl(rawHref) {
      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref || "");
      if (!parsed) return null;
      const rewritten = rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
      return rewritten || parsed.toString();
    }

    function initializeButtonTracking() {
      const anchors = getElements(CONSTANTS.BUTTON_TRACKING.SELECTOR);
      if (!anchors.length) return;

      const pageSlug = (() => {
        const parts = window.location.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
        return parts.length ? parts[parts.length - 1] : "home";
      })();

      const slugify = (str) =>
        str
          .toLowerCase()
          .trim()
          .replace(/[\s\W-]+/g, "-")
          .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");

      anchors.forEach((anchor) => {
        addEvent(anchor, "click", (event) => {
          const text = (anchor.textContent || "").trim();
          if (!text) return;

          const buttonId = anchor.id || `${pageSlug}-button-${slugify(text)}`;
          const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href");
          if (!rawHref) return;

          if (isInPageHashLink(rawHref)) return;

          const parsedRaw = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
          if (parsedRaw && parsedRaw.hash) return;

          const finalUrl = safelyMakeAbsoluteUrl(rawHref);
          if (!finalUrl) return;

          if (
            window.analytics &&
            typeof window.analytics.track === "function"
          ) {
            event.preventDefault();

            let navigated = false;
            const go = () => {
              if (navigated) return;
              navigated = true;
              window.location.href = finalUrl;
            };

            try {
              window.analytics.track(
                CONSTANTS.BUTTON_TRACKING.EVENT_NAME,
                {
                  page: window.location.pathname,
                  button_text: text,
                  button_id: buttonId,
                },
                go,
              );
            } catch (error) {
              console.error(error);
              go();
              return;
            }

            setTimeout(go, CONSTANTS.BUTTON_TRACKING.TIMEOUT_MS);
          }
        });
      });
    }

      //   return

      // fakeDropdowns.forEach(function(el) {
      //   el.removeAttribute('role');
      //   el.removeAttribute('tabindex');
      //   el.removeAttribute('aria-haspopup');
      //   el.removeAttribute('aria-expanded');
      //   el.removeAttribute('aria-controls');

      //   el.style.pointerEvents = 'none';

      //   var link = el.querySelector('a');
      //   if (link) {
      //     link.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
      //   }
      // });

      // var wrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-hidden-default > div:first-child');
      // wrappers.forEach(function(el) {
      //   if (!el.closest('header, main, footer, nav')) {
      //     el.setAttribute('role', 'presentation');

      var banners = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".mega-nav.w-nav, .mega-nav-mobile.w-nav",
      );

        ".toggle-link-block.mega-menu-nav-link",
      );

        el.removeAttribute("role");
        el.removeAttribute("tabindex");
      });

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeProdigyHeader)

function initializeProdigyHeader() {
  if (window.__PRODIGY_HEADER_INITIALIZED__) return
  window.__PRODIGY_HEADER_INITIALIZED__ = true

  const CONSTANTS = {
    LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY: "prodigyLanguage",
    LANGS: {
      EN: "EN",
      ES: "ES",
      PT: "PT"
    },
    PATH_PREFIXES: {
      ES: "/es",
      PT: "/pt",
      EN: "/main-en"
    }
  }

  function safelyGetNavigatorLanguage() {
    try {
      return navigator.language || navigator.userLanguage || ""
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return ""
    }
  }

  function safelyGetLocalStorageItem(key) {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(key)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return null
    }
  }

  function safelySetLocalStorageItem(key, value) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, value)
      return true
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return false
    }
  }

  function normalizeLang(value) {
    if (!value) return null
    const v = String(value).trim().toLowerCase()
    if (v.startsWith("en")) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.EN
    if (v.startsWith("es")) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES
    if (v.startsWith("pt")) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT
    return null
  }

  function safelyParseUrl(url) {
    try {
      return new URL(url, window.location.href)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      return null
    }
  }

  function redirectTo(url) {
    try {
      window.location.replace(url)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error)
      window.location.href = url
    }
  }

  function getSavedLang() {
    return normalizeLang(safelyGetLocalStorageItem(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY))
  }

  function setSavedLang(lang) {
    safelySetLocalStorageItem(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY, lang)
  }

  function getCurrentPathType(pathname) {
    const p = pathname || window.location.pathname || "/"
    if (p.startsWith(CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.ES)) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES
    if (p.startsWith(CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.PT)) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT
    return CONSTANTS.LANGS.EN
  }

  function stripKnownLanguagePrefixes(pathname) {
    const p = pathname || "/"
    const noEsPt = p.replace(/^\/(es|pt)(?=\/|$)/, "")
    const noMainEn = noEsPt.replace(/^\/main-en(?=\/|$)/, "")
    return noMainEn || "/"
  }

  function buildPathForLang(lang, pathname) {
    const stripped = stripKnownLanguagePrefixes(pathname)
    if (lang === CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES) return `${CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.ES}${stripped}`
    if (lang === CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT) return `${CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.PT}${stripped}`
    return `${CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.EN}${stripped}`
  }

  function getPreferredLang() {
    const saved = getSavedLang()
    if (saved) return saved

    const browser = normalizeLang(safelyGetNavigatorLanguage())
    if (browser === CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.ES
    if (browser === CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT) return CONSTANTS.LANGS.PT

    return CONSTANTS.LANGS.EN
  }

  function autoRedirectIfNeeded() {
    const pathname = window.location.pathname || "/"

    const isExplicitEs = pathname.startsWith(CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.ES)
    const isExplicitPt = pathname.startsWith(CONSTANTS.PATH_PREFIXES.PT)

    if (isExplicitEs || isExplicitPt) return

    const preferred = getPreferredLang()
    const currentType = getCurrentPathType(pathname)

    if (preferred === currentType) return

    const nextPath = buildPathForLang(preferred, pathname)
    const nextUrl = `${nextPath}${window.location.search}${window.location.hash}`
    redirectTo(nextUrl)
  }

  function handleLanguageLinkClick(event) {
    const anchor = event.target && event.target.closest ? event.target.closest("a[hreflang]") : null
    if (!anchor) return

    const lang = normalizeLang(anchor.getAttribute("hreflang"))
    if (!lang) return

    event.preventDefault()
    setSavedLang(lang)

    const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || ""
    const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref)
    if (!parsed) return

    redirectTo(parsed.toString())
  }
}
</script>

<script>
  document.querySelectorAll('.testimonial-player').forEach((player) => {
    const video = player.querySelector('.testimonial-video');
    const playButton = player.querySelector('.play-button-testimonial');
    const playPauseBtn = player.querySelector('.playPauseBtn');
    const progressBar = player.querySelector('.testimonial-progress-bar');
    const progressFilled = player.querySelector('.progress-filled-testimonial');
    const controls = player.querySelector('.controls-testimonial');

    let previewMode = true; // loop 3s before play, muted until user presses play

    // Preview looping
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
      if (previewMode && video.currentTime >= 3) {
        video.pause();
        video.currentTime = 0;
        video.play();
      }
    });

    function startRealPlayback() {
      if (!previewMode) return;

      previewMode = false; // disables preview loop
      video.muted = false;
      video.currentTime = 0;
      video.play(); // starts real playback

      playButton.style.display = 'none';
      controls.style.opacity = 1;
      controls.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
    }

    function togglePlay() {
      if (previewMode) {
        startRealPlayback();
        return;
      }

      if (video.paused || video.ended) {
        video.play();
      } else {
        video.pause();
      }
    }

    function updateButton() {
      playPauseBtn.textContent = video.paused ? '▶' : '⏸';

      if (!previewMode) {
        playButton.style.display = video.paused ? 'flex' : 'none';
      }
    }

    function handleProgress() {
      if (!previewMode) {
        const percent = (video.currentTime / video.duration) * 100;
        progressFilled.style.width = percent + '%';
      }
    }

    function scrub(e) {
      if (previewMode) return;

      const scrubTime = (e.offsetX / progressBar.offsetWidth) * video.duration;
      video.currentTime = scrubTime;
    }

    playButton.addEventListener('click', togglePlay);
    playPauseBtn.addEventListener('click', togglePlay);

    video.addEventListener('play', updateButton);
    video.addEventListener('pause', updateButton);
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', handleProgress);

    progressBar.addEventListener('click', scrub);
  });
</script>

        );
        const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
      }

      if (!domain || !ssoBase || !mainEnBase || !ssoHostname) {
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
      }

      for (const prefix of CONSTANTS.CONTENT_PREFIXES) {
        if (
          parsed.pathname.startsWith(prefix) &&
          isSameSiteAfterNormalization
        ) {
          const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
            window.location.origin,
            `${mainEnBase}${parsed.pathname}`,
            parsed.search,
            parsed.hash,
          );
          const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
          return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
        }
      }

      if (
        (parsed.pathname.startsWith("/teacher") ||
          parsed.pathname.startsWith("/parent")) &&
        (isSameSiteAfterNormalization || isSsoHostAfterNormalization)
      ) {
        if (TEACHER_EXCEPTION_SET.has(pathname))
          return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());

        if (CONSTANTS.SSO_PRESERVE_TEACHER_PARENT_ROUTES) {
          const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
            ssoBase,
            parsed.pathname,
            parsed.search || "?signup=true",
            parsed.hash,
          );
          if (!rebuilt.searchParams.has("signup"))
            rebuilt.searchParams.set("signup", "true");
          const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
          return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
        }

        const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
          ssoBase,
          "/signup",
          parsed.search || "?signup=true",
          parsed.hash,
        );
        const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
      }

      if (isSsoHostAfterNormalization) {
        const rebuilt = buildUrlWithParts(
          ssoBase,
          parsed.pathname,
          parsed.search,
          parsed.hash,
        );
        const localized = appendLocaleParameter(rebuilt.toString());
        return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(localized);
      }

      return rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
    }

    function rewriteAnchor(anchor) {
      if (anchor.dataset[CONSTANTS.SSO_REWRITE_DATASET_KEY] === "1") return;

      const nextHref = computeRewrittenHref(anchor);
      if (!nextHref) return;

      const currentHref = anchor.getAttribute("href") || "";
      if (currentHref !== nextHref) {
        anchor.setAttribute("href", nextHref);
      }

      anchor.dataset[CONSTANTS.SSO_REWRITE_DATASET_KEY] = "1";
    }

    function rewriteInternalLinksOnce() {
      getElements("a[href]").forEach(rewriteAnchor);
    }

    function observeAndRewriteInsertedLinks() {
      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const mutation of mutations) {
          for (const node of mutation.addedNodes) {
            if (!(node instanceof Element)) continue;

            if (node.tagName === "A" && node.hasAttribute("href")) {
              rewriteAnchor(node);
              continue;
            }

            const anchors = node.querySelectorAll("a[href]");
            for (const a of anchors) rewriteAnchor(a);
          }
        }
      });

      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    function initializeLogoBehavior() {
      const logo = getElement(SELECTORS.logo);
      addEvent(logo, "click", () => {
        sessionStorage.setItem(CONSTANTS.SKIP_AGE_GATE_SESSION_KEY, "true");
      });
    }

    function initializeAccordionHover() {
      const headers = getElements(SELECTORS.accordionHeaders);
      if (!headers.length) return;

      function syncHoverClass(header) {
        header.classList.toggle(
          "enable-hover",
          !header.classList.contains("w--open"),
        );
      }

      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const mutation of mutations) {
          if (mutation.target instanceof Element)
            syncHoverClass(mutation.target);
        }
      });

      headers.forEach((header) => {
        header.classList.add("enable-hover");
        addEvent(header, "mouseenter", () => {
          if (!header.classList.contains("w--open"))
            header.style.removeProperty("background-color");
        });
        addEvent(header, "mouseleave", () => {
          if (!header.classList.contains("w--open"))
            header.style.removeProperty("background-color");
        });
        observer.observe(header, {
          attributes: true,
          attributeFilter: ["class"],
        });
      });
    }

    function safelyMakeAbsoluteUrl(rawHref) {
      const parsed = safelyParseUrl(rawHref || "");
      if (!parsed) return null;
      const rewritten = rewriteProdigyHostnameInUrl(parsed.toString());
      return rewritten || parsed.toString();
    }

    function initializeButtonTracking() {
      const anchors = getElements(CONSTANTS.BUTTON_TRACKING.SELECTOR);
      if (!anchors.length) return;

      const pageSlug = (() => {
        const parts = window.location.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
        return parts.length ? parts[parts.length - 1] : "home";
      })();

      const slugify = (str) =>
        str
          .toLowerCase()
          .trim()
          .replace(/[\s\W-]+/g, "-")
          .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");

      anchors.forEach((anchor) => {
        addEvent(anchor, "click", (event) => {
          const text = (anchor.textContent || "").trim();
          if (!text) return;

          const buttonId = anchor.id || `${pageSlug}-button-${slugify(text)}`;
          const rawHref = anchor.getAttribute("href");
          if (!rawHref) return;

          if (isInPageHashLink(rawHref)) return;

          const parsedRaw = safelyParseUrl(rawHref);
          if (parsedRaw && parsedRaw.hash) return;

          const finalUrl = safelyMakeAbsoluteUrl(rawHref);
          if (!finalUrl) return;

          if (
            window.analytics &&
            typeof window.analytics.track === "function"
          ) {
            event.preventDefault();

            let navigated = false;
            const go = () => {
              if (navigated) return;
              navigated = true;
              window.location.href = finalUrl;
            };

            try {
              window.analytics.track(
                CONSTANTS.BUTTON_TRACKING.EVENT_NAME,
                {
                  page: window.location.pathname,
                  button_text: text,
                  button_id: buttonId,
                },
                go,
              );
            } catch (error) {
              console.error(error);
              go();
              return;
            }

            setTimeout(go, CONSTANTS.BUTTON_TRACKING.TIMEOUT_MS);
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function initializeLanguageDropdownVisibility() {
      const desktop = getElement(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.DESKTOP);
      const mobile = getElement(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.MOBILE);
      // const ptElements = getElements("#pt")

      // if (!desktop && !mobile) return

      // if (!hostname.endsWith(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.VISIBLE_TLD)) {
      //   ptElements.forEach(el => el.classList.add(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.HIDDEN_CLASS))
      //   return

      if (desktop)
        desktop.classList.remove(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.HIDDEN_CLASS);
      if (mobile)
        mobile.classList.remove(CONSTANTS.LANGUAGE_DROPDOWN.HIDDEN_CLASS);
    }

      // var fakeDropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('#w-dropdown-toggle-2, #w-dropdown-toggle-14');
      // fakeDropdowns.forEach(function(el) {
      //   el.removeAttribute('role');
      //   el.removeAttribute('tabindex');
      //   el.removeAttribute('aria-haspopup');
      //   el.removeAttribute('aria-expanded');
      //   el.removeAttribute('aria-controls');

      //   el.style.pointerEvents = 'none';

      //   var link = el.querySelector('a');
      //   if (link) {
      //     link.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
      //   }
      // });

      // var wrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-hidden-default > div:first-child');
      // wrappers.forEach(function(el) {
      //   if (!el.closest('header, main, footer, nav')) {
      //     el.setAttribute('role', 'presentation');
      //   }
      // });
      var banners = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".mega-nav.w-nav, .mega-nav-mobile.w-nav",
      );
      banners.forEach(function (el) {
        el.removeAttribute("role");
      });

      var nestedButtons = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".toggle-link-block.mega-menu-nav-link",
      );
      nestedButtons.forEach(function (el) {
        el.removeAttribute("role");
        el.removeAttribute("tabindex");
      });

      var navs = document.querySelectorAll('.w-nav-menu[role="navigation"]');
      navs.forEach(function (nav, index) {
        if (!nav.getAttribute("aria-label")) {
          nav.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            index === 0 ? "Primary" : "Mobile " + index,
          );
        }
      });

      var badToggles = document.querySelectorAll(
        "#w-dropdown-toggle-2, #w-dropdown-toggle-14",
      );
      badToggles.forEach(function (el) {
        el.removeAttribute("role");
        el.removeAttribute("tabindex");
        el.removeAttribute("aria-haspopup");
        el.removeAttribute("aria-expanded");
        el.removeAttribute("aria-controls");
        el.classList.remove("w-dropdown-toggle");
        el.replaceWith(el.cloneNode(true));
      });

      var container = document.querySelector(".nav-hidden-default");
      if (container && !container.closest("header")) {
        var header = document.createElement("header");
        header.setAttribute("role", "banner");
        container.parentNode.insertBefore(header, container);
        header.appendChild(container);
      }

      var links = document.querySelectorAll(".link-underline.link-black");
      links.forEach(function (el) {
        el.style.color = "#000000";
      });
    }

    initializeNavbar();
    initializeAgeGate();
    rewriteInternalLinksOnce();
    observeAndRewriteInsertedLinks();
    initializeLogoBehavior();
    initializeAccordionHover();
    initializeHashNavigation();
    initializeButtonTracking();
    initializeLanguageDropdownVisibility();
    initializeAccessibilityFix();
  }
</script>
